scientific_findings: 1. Path_Loss_No_RIS is identical across all 4 RIS configurations for a given UE (std = 0.0 dB). 2. Predicting Path_Loss_With_RIS directly is the primary wireless engineering goal and yields R² ~ 0.97. 3. RIS_Gain has a very narrow dynamic range in this scenario (-0.34 dB to +0.71 dB, total span ~1.05 dB), making direct regression sensitive to tiny phase-interference nuances. Direct modeling achieves MAE ~ 0.05 dB.
